subject.title: [Bug]: WeChat channel session permanently corrupted after ingesting binary file attachments

question: Should this WeChat binary-ingestion failure be fixed as a core reply-session/tool-result recovery bug, routed to the external WeChat plugin, or split across the existing related issues?
rationale: The observed failure crosses OpenClaw core session initialization, provider/tool-result placeholder behavior, and an external WeChat media path, so automation should not pick the permanent owner boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split by owner boundary
options.body: Keep this issue as the WeChat-specific evidence while maintaining core work in the related reply-session and placeholder-output issues, and ask the WeChat plugin owner for binary-media repro data.

options.title: Promote a core recovery fix
options.body: Treat persistent reply-session conflicts after channel media ingestion as core state recovery work and leave plugin media decoding as follow-up.

options.title: Route fully to WeChat plugin
options.body: Close or transfer only after maintainers decide the core conflict and placeholder symptoms are already covered elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Split by owner boundary
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the WeChat-specific evidence while maintaining core work in the related reply-session and placeholder-output issues, and ask the WeChat plugin owner for binary-media repro data.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the WeChat external-plugin docs, AI runtime placeholder path, and recent session-thread work where `steipete` appears in history.
